newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends softer as Tokyo falls.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends softer as Tokyo falls.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended softer after a lower close in Tokyo and as thin demand dampened sentiment, dealers said.
"Falls in Tokyo and the slow buying interest from consumers pulled down prices today," a dealer said.
But some dealers said the fall could be brief and prices could rebound in the short-term due to speculation of nearby tight-supply because of the wintering period.
Only scattered enquiries were seen from Asian and European countries but dealers said they were just checking the price levels.
